steps.until:
float fM1
ref rF1
ref rP
ref rD
float fV
Begin Function { }
let fM1 := GetModIndex "FalloutNV.esm"
let rF1 := BuildRef fM1 1064545
let rP := player.GetParentCell
let rD := rF1.GetParentCell
if rP == rD
  let fV := 0
else
  let fV := 1
endif
SetFunctionValue fV
End

float fV
Begin Function { }
if player.GetPos X > 53248
  if player.GetPos X < 61440
    let fV := 1
  endif
endif
SetFunctionValue fV
End
